name: BrisNet
summary: Brisbane ISP; began 1996 as a community not-for-profit network, now a commercial ADSL + wireless + NBN + hosting provider; still active (INTPAY PTY LTD, ACN 106 545 073).

events.details: Earliest Wayback capture 30 Oct 1996 (brisnet.org.au); page last changed 26 Oct 1996; March 1996 minutes linked; started as a Brisbane community ISP.

Present operator INTPAY PTY LTD (ACN 106 545 073, ABN 80 106 545 073, QLD) is an Australian private company registered 07 Oct 2003 — seven years after the 1996 community founding — and its internet-related ABR business names (Soft-Tech Internet, Country Hosting & Internet Provider Services) date only from 2018/2022. The live brisnet.org.au footer carries this ABN, so INTPAY trades as Brisnet today; whether this commercial entity is a direct continuation of the original community BrisNet or a later takeover of the brand/domain is uncertain.
